		American Law
	


	
		
	
	
		Gathered by Kyle Rose
	


	
		
	
	
		Description
	

Municipal and County Laws from across the United States, in parquet format.
Files are named after a location's GNIS id and what they contain.
Unless specified otherwise, each row is one sub-section of a law. 
It is the one of the smallest units of law that can be cited under the Bluebook Citation method.
For convenience's sake, these will be referred to as "law" for the rest of this document.
